map.第二个十六进制的最低位为 1 表示本地管理（Universally vs Loc: The lowest bit of the second hexadecimal character being 1 indicates a locally administered address (universally vs locally).
map.生成的 MAC 能用在真实网卡上吗？: Can a generated MAC be used on a real network adapter?
map.可以临时改（部分网卡支持「本地管理地址」），但要注意两点：一是第 1 字节第 2: You can change it temporarily (some adapters support locally administered addresses), but keep two things in mind. First, the second-lowest bit of the first byte must be 1 to mark a locally administered address (as opposed to the globally unique address burned in by the vendor), otherwise you may clash with a real device. Second, do not use them at scale on a production network — it causes ARP confusion and makes auditing difficult.
map.MAC 地址：网络接口的物理标识，48 位（6 组十六进制，如 00:1A:2B: MAC address: the physical identifier of a network interface, 48 bits (6 hexadecimal groups, e.g. 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E), where the first 3 groups are the vendor identifier (OUI).
